purpose.domain_detail: Warehouse/stock validity report for a Brazilian distribution or retail system; tracks product expiry dates by deposit/warehouse and packaging unit
purpose.summary: PW03017R is a batch report program that generates a stock validity (expiry date) report. It reads sorted stock records by deposit, product, and expiry date, and produces both a formatted print report and a CSV output listing quantities by pallet, layer, sales unit, and loose units per product validity date. The program is part of a larger Brazilian retail/distribution ERP system.

notable_features: Conditional CSV output via $if PadraoCSV defined
28 COPY statements for modular copybook structure
Indexed file with dynamic access (arqsor sort file)
CSV report generation alongside traditional print report
